title: Jira Export: Sprint 47 Dashboard Features
user_story: Sprint 47 dashboard features — new analytics widget, export button relocation, real-time refresh, legacy chart removal.

golden_changes.name: Analytics Dashboard Widget
golden_changes.description: Customizable analytics dashboard widget with drag-and-drop positioning and resizing.

golden_changes.name: Export Button Relocation
golden_changes.description: Move Export to CSV button from toolbar to widget header dropdown.

golden_changes.name: Real-Time Data Refresh
golden_changes.description: WebSocket-based real-time data refresh with configurable intervals.

golden_changes.name: Legacy Chart Library
golden_changes.description: Remove Chart.js v2 dependency — all charts migrated to v4.

golden_conditions: Verify analytics dashboard widget can be added and configured
Verify export button is in widget header dropdown
Verify real-time data refresh updates metrics at configured interval
Verify dashboard loads without Chart.js v2 dependency
